assertions: Public release identity is v2.0.0 while r31c remains the internal source revision.
Historical milestone hashes remain provenance; intentionally advanced files are owned by this checkpoint.
r31c does not install or service the retired r30 Win+Alt+B keyboard interception path.
Any detected display-domain or HDR resize transition arms a hard DLSS-G reset and forces FG OFF.
DLSS-G OFF must commit on a successful real Present before slFreeResources(kFeatureDLSS_G, viewport) is called.
A successful resource purge invalidates local DLSS-G options, frame tokens, tags, dimensions, formats and warmup state rather than reusing the old FG session.
If the HDR bridge generation advances, FG cannot rearm until that bridge transition settles and the retained two-fresh-frame gate completes.

If the display domain changes but Control issues no ResizeBuffers, r31c waits 30 real Presents after both resource free and the latest display-domain flip, then requires two consecutive fresh tagged frames before same-generation rearm.
A late ResizeBuffers during the no-bridge grace window still takes ownership through the existing bridge-generation recovery path.
Control remains owner of its swapchain; r31c does not destroy or recreate the game swapchain itself.
Historical milestone hash validation must skip every path owned by the current-release checkpoint; release validation rejects any unguarded historical tested_sha256 loop.

The hard-reset invalidation path resets the declared shared slLastBackBufferIndex tracker; packaging rejects the undeclared slFgLastBackBufferIndex regression that caused the first r31 MSVC C2065 failure.
The display observer records the HDR bridge generation associated with the display domain it actually observed.

If the bridge generation has advanced since that observation and the bridge already matches the newly observed HDR/SDR domain, the display flip is a delayed duplicate and must not arm another hard reset.
Early display-domain detection where the bridge has not yet transitioned still arms the normal hard reset.
The r31b hold_fg_off_waiting_for_resize deadlock with bridge_generation=0 is covered by portable no-bridge grace and two-fresh-frame rearm regression cases.
Live Windows/MSVC, Streamline runtime and game/GPU behavior still require target-system sign-off.

The complete Dynamic Target FPS block (header, Auto/Manual, target readout, slider and endpoint labels) is visible and interactive only while Dynamic FG is selected; hidden Dynamic controls cannot mutate the saved target.
Off and fixed 2X-6X modes remove the 220 px Dynamic section from layout, shift the footer/RR controls upward, and shrink the overlay from 730 px to 510 px with no reserved blank gap.
RTX 20/30 Frame Generation and multi-FG support remain roadmap-only; no older-GPU compatibility code or architecture rewriting is present in this release cleanup.
The public binary drop-in must not contain internal r27/r31c milestone text, the duplicate README.txt, or the performance-analysis helper script.
